parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: The industry. After you specify an industry, only content from websites within the specified industry is recalled. Separate multiple industries with commas.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The time range for filtering web page publication dates.

parameters.name: timeRange
parameters.description: The session ID for multi-turn interactions.
